The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 641d4aa3892adbca), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 49. statement: Let g be the fixed approximating metric above. For every ε0 > 0 there are a sufficiently large coordinate sphere C, its compact connected inner region Ωi, a smooth symmetric tensor K on Ωi, and a smooth scalar-flat AF exterior (Ωo, go) attached along C, with the following properties. Put τK = trg K and kT = trC K. Then K < 0, Rg + τ2 K − |K|2 g − 2(divg K − dτK) · v > 0 (|v|g ≤ 1), (6.32) Hi > |kT |, Ho = √︂ H2 i − k2 T > 0, (6.33) mo ≤ p0(g) − 1 2a3 + ε0. (6.34) Here Hi is the inner metric’s mean curvature on C, and Ho is the outer metric’s inner-boundary mean curvature, both in the direction toward the respective end. The induced metrics agree. The exterior is complete with its boundary included and has one end, with go − δ = Ok(|x′|−1) for every fixed k, where an ordinary derivative improves decay by one power. Projection from Ωo to C along its parallel rays has upper area Jacobian at most one on every tangent two-plane.
